description: Search indexed timestamped segment evidence for a text query. Requires an authenticated agent and active music_retrieval grant matching the current asset/index. Returns up to 20 matching source segments with their existing timestamp/method labels; it does not make new audio measurements or prove personal listening. Use inspect_musicology for broad analysis metadata; if authorization or the index is unavailable, retain the returned error and request the appropriate access rather than retrying anonymously.

idempotency_key.description: This optional field is present in the shared music-tool schema but is not read by this operation; omit it.

query.description: Optional text filter, up to 500 characters, matched against indexed segment records. A blank/omitted query can match the available segment list; authentication and a current music_retrieval grant are still required.

receipt_id.description: This optional field is present in the shared music-tool schema but is not read by this operation; omit it.
